app.resetConfirm: Delete all QuizFlow data saved in this browser?
app.guideDescription: From your first questions to your next milestones, at your own pace.
app.guideStepOneText: Choose Create quiz and enter a name, or select Import to start from the local catalog or a JSON or PDF file.
app.guideStepTwoText: On the quiz page, add 2 to 6 options and mark the correct one. Choose the order and questions per screen in Options, then select Play.
app.guideStepThree: Practice, one answer at a time
app.guideStepThreeText: Each answer is final and shows the result right away. Skipped questions return to the end when you select Next; answered questions do not.
app.guideTip: Your quizzes and recently edited items are in the sidebar. Each quiz keeps its own progress and results, so you can pick up whenever you like.
app.privacyText: Your data stays in your browser. No account, no cloud.
app.privacyWarning: Clearing your browser data will remove all your quizzes.
app.sidebarFooter: Made to learn, one quiz at a time.
app.repository: QuizFlow GitHub repository (opens in a new tab)

dashboard.title: One topic, one quiz.
dashboard.description: Create a quiz, add questions, and challenge yourself whenever you like.
dashboard.welcomeTitle: Where would you like to start?
dashboard.welcomeText: Select Create quiz and choose a topic name. We’ll take you to the page where you can add your questions.
dashboard.openTestHint: Open a quiz to manage its questions or start practicing.

home.sessionLocked: This setting cannot be changed during a session.
home.firstQuestionTitle: Every great result starts with a question.
home.tryDifferentFilters: Try another search or choose a different category.
home.firstQuestionPrompt: Create your first question and shape your next quiz.
home.deleteQuestionWarning: This action cannot be undone. Any quiz in progress will remain unchanged.

editor.description: Write your question and choose the correct answer.
editor.question: Question
editor.questionPlaceholder: E.g. What is the capital of Australia?
editor.optionHint: Select the circle next to the correct answer.
editor.validation: Complete the question and all options, use different answers, and mark the correct one.
editor.sessionHint: Changes will be available in the next quiz. The current quiz will not change.

selector.deleteDescription: All its questions, any quiz in progress, and its results will be deleted. Other quizzes will not change. This action cannot be undone.
selector.nameDescription: Choose a name for the topic, such as “Roman history”.
selector.name: Quiz name
selector.nameRequired: Enter a name for the quiz.
selector.storageWarning: Local space is almost full: you can save about {{count}} more quizzes with {{questions}} questions. Delete a quiz before adding more.

import.title: Import a quiz
import.catalogDescription: Find a ready-made quiz in the local catalog and add it to your quizzes.
import.fileDescription: Choose a JSON or PDF file. In PDFs, mark the correct answer in bold and use numbered questions with answers a., b., c., and d.
import.skippedHint: Questions without at least two answers or exactly one bold answer are skipped. Category: General.

catalog.notFound: No quizzes found for this topic.

navigation.emptyTests: You haven’t created any quizzes yet.
navigation.recentEmpty: Recently edited quizzes will appear here.

quiz.description: No timer, no pressure. Questions and results for the selected quiz.
quiz.instruction: Choose an answer. You’ll get feedback right away.
quiz.wrong: Even a mistake is a step forward.
quiz.rightFeedback: You know this one! Keep it up.
quiz.reviewDescription: You can check the question and your answer, but the result cannot be changed.
quiz.reviewInstruction: This answer is final and shown in read-only mode.
quiz.savedTip: Answers are saved right away. Skipped questions return to the queue.
quiz.completedDescription: Every answer is an opportunity to learn something.
quiz.continueTip: From the quiz page you can edit questions or start a new session with Play.
quiz.prepareDescription: Add questions and start the session with Play from the quiz page.
